## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: breadth is mixed (Real Estate/Utilities/Materials leading while Technology and Financials lag) and leadership is narrow (Top 5: 3/5 Real Estate), with major divergence among megacaps—watch for trend break.

2. Which sectors are leading?

Utilities strong: EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND. Materials notable: NEM (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +10.21%) ABOVE TREND.

Financials weak: JPM (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND.

Top 1W movers: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence among megacaps (MSFT, META, AAPL) — tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Technology showing broad weakness and stock-level divergences: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY — sector 1W: -1.88% (19 stocks) and acting as a headwind.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials under pressure: JPM (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: -4.45% (20 stocks) and lacking leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed/defensive: JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: -0.27% (15 stocks) with pockets of strength but headline divergence on sentiment.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to Real Estate and Utilities (EQIX, AMT, EXC) and monitor cyclical names showing confirmed strength (CAT); reduce exposure to high-multiple Technology names under pressure (AAPL, INTU, INTC) and to lagging Financials until weekly trends stabilize. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat current moves as selective opportunities.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +21.49%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -29.51%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Real Estate, Utilities, Materials (7/11 sectors positive overall). BEARISH: Technology, Financials, Consumer Discretionary — monitor breadth shifts within these groups.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch weekly follow-through for ORCL (RECOVERY) to confirm a sustainable turnaround; watch whether AAPL (BELOW TREND) extends weekly weakness or stabilizes above its 1M trend; monitor JPM (BELOW TREND) for failure to reclaim weekly momentum which would keep Financials pressured.

CSCO (+55): CSCO (1W: -9.40% | 1M: +3.28%) CORRECTION — bullish orders story but price diverging (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?

AMT (-45): AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND — tenant/credit headlines diverge from price strength.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among megacaps and several sentiment/price mismatches (CSCO, PFE, AMT) — watch for trend confirmation before adding beta.
